values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A Gas Processing and LNG article from September 2016 says the Gulf Connector expansion was designed to deliver gas to Freeport LNG and to the Corpus Christi LNG terminal. Phase one was 75,000 Dth/d for Freeport and phase two was 400,000 Dth/d for Corpus Christi.

verifications.note: Page names Gulf Connector and says it supplies Freeport LNG and Cheniere's Corpus Christi LNG terminal.

records.researcher_notes: Page read in full. It ties the Gulf Connector project directly to two export terminals.
